Selenium (Se)
	1.	Serum selenium test
	2.	Whole blood levels better 
reflect long-term status.
Margin between deficiency and  
toxicity is narrower for Se than any 
other trace component of the  
antioxidant enzyme element; im-
portant in glutathione peroxidase.
	(1)	 80-320 mcg/L

	(2)	 60-340 mcg/L

Cutoff points for deficiency or

lished.
Iodine (I)
Urinary excretion is best indicator 
of I status, either mcg/24 hr or 
mcg/g creatinine; thyroid hor-
mone level related to I status. 
Urine test can use 50 mg I/KI 
challenge.
Excretion should be 24-hour urine 
.70 mcg/g creatinine.

and thyroglobulin antibodies) for 
improved interpretation.
